text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, when Aston Machan is out for
a walk by
herself...

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text: Um, aren't you Aston Machan?! No way! We're huge fans of yours!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you like a picture? Or better yet,
why
don't we do something together?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of this chance
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Really?!
You'd do that for us?!
We'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Having honeyade with you is a dream come true! I'll never forget this day!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What would you all like to do next? I've
still got
time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! We couldn't possibly ask for any
more of
your time!
You must have a lot
of training to do too...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can train anytime, but this could be the
only
chance we all have to spend time
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan ends up skipping
her
training session.
